significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish the form-(iii) predictive relation that "decode-depth scales with problem difficulty—shallow for easy items, deep for hard ones," with hard items specifically recruiting additional late-layer computation; this constrains expected answer-emergence depth across difficulty levels and supports allocating more layers before an answer is emitted. It establishes a definite phenomenon and a partial mechanism—difficulty-dependent answer emergence and late-layer recruitment—but not a causal decomposition of the computations performed by those layers; this relation bears directly on the limitation faced by confidence-based adaptive-compute approaches such as CALM (Schuster et al., 2022) and on the interpretation of layerwise decoding supplied by the Tuned Lens (Belrose et al., 2023). The branches are distinguishable: a negative result would rule out answer decode-depth as a general mechanistic difficulty signal, although it would not rule out other activation-based adaptive-compute signals. In the topic-substitution check, the generic topic of efficient, interpretable reasoning would not itself warrant this score; the measurable difficulty-to-depth ordering is the claim-specific increment over a median proposal.

reach.justification: The named handles are "decode-depth," defined as the earliest layer with a stable correct decode, and a "depth-adaptive policy" that exits when the answer is confidently decodable. The policy is ex ante with respect to unnecessary deeper-layer computation, leaving an action window to exit the forward pass, whereas decode-depth computed using the known correct answer is primarily a post-hoc diagnostic; this could give inference-system practitioners, not only interpretability researchers, a gating signal analogous in use to but mechanistically distinct from CALM-style confidence exits. After per-model lens calibration, the substantive hypothesis still predicts an ordering—easy items resolve shallower than hard ones—rather than merely prescribing where to look, although the asserted scope is only reasoning models/tasks and does not promise transfer across architectures or modalities. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: efficient reasoning alone supplies neither the depth-based gauge nor the ex-ante layer-exit handle, so the reach comes from the specific conclusion.
